name: Roy Campbell
contribution: A South African poet, literary critic, literary translator, war poet and satirist.

checks.lead: Ignatius Royston Dunnachie Campbell, better known as Roy Campbell (2 October 1901 – 23 April 1957), was a South African poet, literary critic, literary translator, war poet and satirist.  Most of his adult life was spent in Europe.
